# area: typeddict
# hypothesis: ReadOnly items cannot be assigned, NotRequired items need an in-guard before narrowing, and Unpack[TD] rejects unknown or wrongly typed keyword arguments, while a widened int | str value type accepts strings.
from typing import NotRequired, ReadOnly, TypedDict, Unpack, reveal_type


class Movie(TypedDict):
    title: ReadOnly[str]
    year: NotRequired[int]


class Options(TypedDict, total=False):
    verbose: bool
    level: int | str


def configure(**kwargs: Unpack[Options]) -> None:
    reveal_type(kwargs)
    print(kwargs)


m: Movie = {'title': 'Up'}
if 'year' in m:
    reveal_type(m['year'])
print(m.get('year', 0))
m['title'] = 'Down'  # expect-error: ReadOnly
configure(verbose=True)
configure(level='high')
configure(level=1.5)  # expect-error: float is not int | str
configure(color=1)  # expect-error: unknown key
hypothesis: ReadOnly items cannot be assigned, NotRequired items need an in-guard before narrowing, and Unpack[TD] rejects unknown or wrongly typed keyword arguments, while a widened int | str value type accepts strings.
